YASTM.ST_HelpDef.title: Tribble Infestation
YASTM.ST_HelpDef.text: Tribbles are small, non-intelligent lifeforms known for their soft fur, soothing purr, and absolutely terrifying reproductive rate. They are born pregnant.\n\nGameplay: If a Tribble enters your map, it will consume your food stores and multiply exponentially. Left unchecked, they will overrun your colony, crashing both your food supply and your frame rate. Deal with them immediately by culling them or selling them to unsuspecting traders. Klingons gain a mood buff for killing them.

YASTM.ST_HelpDef.title: The Q Continuum
YASTM.ST_HelpDef.text: Q is an omnipotent, god-like entity with a penchant for testing lesser species. He finds humanity particularly amusing.\n\nGameplay: Q visits are entirely unpredictable. He might instantly heal your entire colony, drop rare resources, or decide to turn all your plasteel into wood just for a laugh. There is no defense against a Q visit. You are at his mercy.

YASTM.ST_HelpDef.title: Vat-Grown Soldiers
YASTM.ST_HelpDef.text: The Dominion does not recruit; it manufactures its armies. The Jem'Hadar are bred for combat and mature in a matter of days.\n\nGameplay: Once researched, you can build a Cloning Vat. By combining raw meat (biomass) and Neutroamine, you can gestate Jem'Hadar and Vorta clones over several days. When the process is complete, a colonist must manually open the stasis pod to decant the new pawn, who will instantly join your faction.

YASTM.ST_HelpDef.title: Ketracel-White
YASTM.ST_HelpDef.text: Ketracel-White is an isogenic enzyme crucial to the survival of the Jem'Hadar. They are genetically engineered to lack this enzyme to ensure absolute loyalty to the Founders.\n\nGameplay: Jem'Hadar pawns do not eat normal food, but they MUST consume Ketracel-White regularly. If they run out, they will enter severe withdrawal, eventually going berserk and attacking anything in sight before dying. Always secure a steady supply of Neutroamine and Chemfuel to synthesize it!

YASTM.ST_HelpDef.title: Transporter Systems
YASTM.ST_HelpDef.text: Transporters convert matter into an energy pattern, beam it to a target location, and reassemble it flawlessly. Mostly.\n\nGameplay: Transporter pads allow instant travel across the map. They require immense power and have a cooldown period after use. Beware: Ion storms or solar flares will render transporters offline. Do not attempt to beam during a power failure.
